question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS donation_count,
    SUM("Amount") AS total_donor_amount
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(total_donor_amount) AS total_collected,
    SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN total_donor_amount ELSE 0 END) AS recurring_donor_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recurring_donor_count
  FROM donor_counts
)
SELECT
  (recurring_donor_amount / NULLIF(total_collected, 0)) * 100 AS percent,
  recurring_donor_count
FROM metrics;
```
